notes.title: 1.1.1 Update
notes.content: We have fixed an issue where the respawn time for the hero Lyla was calculated incorrectly, which in some cases caused abnormal respawn time behavior.

tags.bug: We have fixed an issue where the respawn time for the hero Lyla was calculated incorrectly, which in some cases caused abnormal respawn time behavior.

notes.title: 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
1. Reduce minecart damage to allies and increase damage to zombies.
2. Decrease the firing rate of bullet traps but increase their per-shot damage.
3. Lower the difficulty to unlock new units.
4. Significantly buff the damage of suicide Demolitionist.
5. Slightly increase the Tesla Trooper's pulling force.
6. Change Commander Lyla's starting ability to "Field Medic."
7. Nerf Commander Hawk’s explosion radius.
8. Reduce enemy HP in the first level.

notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Balance: [/h3]
1. Commander Lyla has been added the Combat Medic skill: Heals the unit with the lowest HP.
2. Commander Lyla’s default skill has been changed to: Increases revival speed for the entire team.
3. Commander Hawk’s HP regeneration rate adjusted from 8 to 5.
4. Commander Dane’s HP regeneration rate adjusted from 8 to 10.

[h3]Technical:[/h3]
1. Fixed a bug where Steam achievements could not be unlocked under certain circumstances.
